PART II - RULES 12B-25(B) AND (C)

If the subject report could not be filed without unreasonable effort or expense
and the registrant seeks relief pursuant to Rule 12b-25b, the following should
be completed.

  X   (a)   The reasons described in reasonable detail in Part III of this form
            could not be eliminated without unreasonable effort or expense;

  X   (b)   The subject annual report, or semi-annual report, transition report
            on Form 10-K, Form 20-F, Form 11-K, Form N-SAR, or portion thereof,
            will be filed on or before the fifteenth calendar day following the
            prescribed due date; or the subject quarterly report or transition
            report on Form 10-Q, or portion thereof, will be filed on or before
            the fifth calendar day following the prescribed due date; and

  X   (c)   The accountant s statement or other exhibit required by Rule 12b-
            25(c) has been attached if applicable.

PART III - NARRATIVE

State below in reasonable detail the reasons why the Form 10-K, 11-K, 10-Q, N-
SAR, or the transition report or portion thereof, could not be filed within the
prescribed time period.  (Attach Extra Sheets if Needed).

The Company will be unable to file its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 
March 31, 1997 by the required due date as a result of the substantial time 
which has been devoted to two transactions which the Company is attempting to 
finalize. The redomestication and concurrent sale of the Company s North 
Carolina-domiciled insurance subsidiary is expected to be completed in June 
1997. The planned merger of the Company with a subsidiary of LaSalle Group, 
Inc. has also required significant time due to delays by LaSalle in providing 
appropriate evidence of funding to state insurance regulators.
